purpose: Automate bounded multi-source evidence collection and selection around the FORGE engine in this repository.
primary_acceptance: Original FORGE source, tests, budgets, and verifier remain unchanged.
Normal frozen FORGE corpus inspection is actually called for admitted Python inputs.
Full definition text preserves searchable annotations; references and unsupported-language text are separate evidence kinds.
All results bind to source hashes and explicit captured-content provenance.
Fixed reciprocal-rank fusion has no target labels or target-specific synonym list.
No claims of semantic correctness, demand, novelty, independent inference, or executed source arise from retrieval.
A task cannot run before its dependencies; source failure does not become source absence.
Bounded work checkpoints resume, completed records are verified before reuse, and cancellation prevents new tasks.
Source and aggregate byte budgets, query counts and packet bytes are enforced without weakening FORGE.
References cannot satisfy an implementation-only requirement and lexical text cannot satisfy observed-API filters.
The reviewer handoff is bounded and points to separately retained detailed evidence.
No model calls, deployments, or arbitrary source executions are permitted by this runner.
predictions: Keeping full-source lexical leads should recover some metadata misses, but may regress other rankings; report all outcomes.
Literature/reference search should supply context, never automatically prove a product gap.
Fixed snapshot and query reruns should reproduce semantic results; elapsed time is separate telemetry.
evaluation: Developer-authored development scenarios. Prior public pilot is diagnostic replay, not holdout. New sources are not guaranteed unknown to the model.
promotion: An add-on development candidate only. Any failure of unchanged baseline qualification remains a release block.
